Her design is illustrated by [[Ayakura Juu]] and features a younger version of Yukari with [[short hair]], grey [[school uniform]], [[cardigan]], and [[thighhighs]].
Yuzuriha and [[Kido hyde|Hyde]] were once childhood friends until an unspecified incident occurred which split them apart from each other.
Her name in Polish ([[vanripper]], Polish game creator) means literally betrayal, treason or adultery.
Appears in [[Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance]] as a minor NPC and in [[Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn]] as a major antagonist.
The [[polygamy|first]] wife of [[Paul Greyrat]] and the mother to [[Rudeus Greyrat]].
An [[aged down]] version of [[Azur Lane]]'s [[Graf Zeppelin (azur lane)|]].
Her appearance in [[Darling in the Franxx]] as a child.
A character in [[Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club]].
She's a transfer student from Hong Kong and fluent in 3 languages (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese).

Her [[Nijigasaki school uniform]] is modified quite heavily, with a [[black shirt]] instead of a white one and a [[red cardigan]] (for her [[winter uniform]]) or [[red sweater vest]] (for her [[summer uniform]]).
28 years old.
